scientific_questions.ranking: Compare each of seven methods on its stated domain, the original five common domain and the common seven-method domain. A non-positive family-macro change falsifies an observed improvement on that cohort.
scientific_questions.fine_tuning: The designated suffix has finite nonzero task gradients across at least three minibatches before AdamW and changes after training. Skill gains require independent empirical evidence. A changed file alone is insufficient.
scientific_questions.resolution: Expect paired R1 minus B0 to raise RGB error and potentially lower coverage. Zero and negative changes are retained, including the least favourable family.
scientific_questions.color_rounding: Expect a much smaller change in RGB error for Q1 minus B0 than for R1 minus B0. Record identical tensors or scores as ties and report negative results.
scientific_questions.novelty: Report four novel-template and four familiar-category layouts separately without representing either group as a general population.

target: Mean absolute display-sRGB error across three channels strictly above 0.05 on finite paired RGB. Depth is an auxiliary physical evaluation.

input.policy: Whole condition-specific predicted target RGB, aspect-preserving bilinear letterbox, centered padding, pixel-center inverse map and support mask. Never crop. Numerical features use original calibrated camera grids.
input.features: 384 to 32 visual channels, then concatenate 26 legal numerical channels, 58 to 32 to one logit. Family and split are unavailable to the scorer.

supervision.family_weight: equal family mass; equal supported view mass within family, fixed eligible samples per view
supervision.pilot: Four designated new train families only; fine-tune branch seed A. At most 32 optimizer updates. Pilot excluded from model selection.

fit.trainable: L2-frozen projection plus head; L2-vision-ft also pretrained blocks 10 and 11 plus terminal norm. Frozen state must be bitwise stable.
fit.replication: Both modes run both respective learning rates at seed A. For each mode retain the LR of highest development family-equal shared-domain AP, tie lower LR and earliest maximum epoch. Refit both selected configurations at seeds B and C. Report all eight fits. Primary package for each mode is its selected A run.

logistic_baselines.preprocessing: Training-fold-only within grouped family cross-validation; refit on training only.

evaluation.low_rule: finite score < tau. Target 0.8 family-macro coverage of reference-valid pixels over full development images, whole score ties, prefer lower coverage on a tie; score failure is unknown.
evaluation.statistics: AP by target then family over defined two-class views; publish count of undefined views. Pool raw counts per family for rates, then equal-weight families. Report V, evaluable E, supported and unknown, low/error/positive/warnings, invalid output and acquisition failures.
evaluation.new_confirmations: Unlock all eight simultaneously after formal model identity, three seeds per method, thresholds, default selection, CPU cost and display rule have been fixed. No changes using new test results.
evaluation.show: v01 per family and condition, full index v01 to v06, no quality filter.

deployment_decision.rule: Select seed-A L2-vision-ft as default only if each of its three development AP values exceeds the refitted L1-full AP, mean paired FT minus frozen AP exceeds the across-seed sample standard deviation of the paired differences, all three paired results exist, and measured Mac 512-square full-view hot p95 <= 5 s and process-tree peak RSS <= 2147483648 bytes. Otherwise keep L1-full. Publish and test the two neural modes in either case.
deployment_decision.cpu_cost: Fresh process to first written output, six full views then warm repeats, per-view wall p50 and p95, peak process plus children RSS. Include IO, projection, numerical features, full encoder, head and writing.
